synthesize.description: Synthesize at most 5000 code points to an MP3 file. Always requests the timestamp envelope. The answer must contain nonempty canonical base64 audio, audio/mpeg content_type, a finite positive duration, and equal graph_chars/graph_times arrays containing strings and finite start/end pairs. Otherwise returns vendor_error with reason unexpected answer and writes nothing. The gateway enforces a 16777216-byte file cap. Word timings drop square-bracket and angle-bracket tags; character timings preserve both arrays; none omits timings.

list_builtin_voices.description: List built-in voices as voice_id and name. A non-object answer, missing voices array, or voice without string voice_id and name returns vendor_error with reason unexpected answer.

list_voice_clones.description: List the team's voice clones as voice_id and name, retaining language and creation fields only when they are strings, plus a string pagination_token when present. A non-object answer, missing voices array, or voice without string voice_id and name returns vendor_error with reason unexpected answer.
